_doc: Monotone-shrink ratchet budget for the conformance matrix. Each key is the exact suite name emitted by conformance-matrix.py; `ledgered` is the allowed count of ledgered gaps (the XFail/Skip column). The gate asserts the live count EQUALS this budget: a larger count (a regressed or newly-ledgered gap) fails RED, and a smaller count (a fixed gap) also fails RED until the budget is lowered here to lock the gain. This budget is authoritative and may only ever be edited DOWNWARD; a raise must be justified in review. Reasons describe the technical gap only.

SPARQL 1.1/1.2 evaluation (full corpus).note: 5 upstream-errata fixtures with non-canonical XSD lexicals (cast-decimal/double/float, coalesce01, plus-1-corrected); the entailment-regime cases (OWL-Direct/DL via the ALCOIQ tableau, RIF-rule, RDF-axiomatic-triple) are all native now

Entailment (OWL 2 DL consistency).note: vendored W3C OWL 2 suite (261 consistency/inconsistency cases) graded against the OWL-Direct ALCOIQ tableau; 5 ledgered divergences, each typed in crates/sparql-conformance/src/owl2.rs::LEDGER — 2 bottom-property (the empty built-in role reads as an ordinary named role; the run RAISES the builtin-role boundary for it), 1 distinct-literals (a functional data property with two different literal values, which needs a concrete domain), 1 empty-domain (OWL 2 forbids the empty interpretation domain) and 1 withheld run (a cyclic class expression the parser refuses). Lowered from 28: the reverse mapping now reads the role characteristics (transitive/symmetric/asymmetric/reflexive/irreflexive/inverse-functional), role and property disjointness, owl:differentFrom and owl:AllDifferent, owl:AllDisjointClasses, owl:hasKey, owl:hasSelf and owl:NegativePropertyAssertion instead of dropping them, and the sameAs re-statement pass no longer tries to put a literal in subject position. No ledgered divergence is an unsoundness. Consistency-shaped: this row does NOT measure the OWL 2 RL rule table. The corpus is also a SUBSET: it vendors 261 of the 482 consistency-shaped cases in the upstream manifest, and the harness's OWL2-DL-EXCLUDED line measures the other 221 — 156 of them the tableau DECIDES today (93 consistent, 63 inconsistent), so the exclusion was payload-size triage, not a capability limit; 30 do not terminate under a 40 s ceiling (the previously-claimed 32 was inherited, not measured), 12 are withheld (7 reasoner, 5 parse) and 23 carry no RDF/XML premise. Reading 256/261 as coverage of what W3C published overstates it

Entailment (OWL 2 RL, W3C entailment tes.note: W3C's own OWL 2 entailment tests (crates/sparql-conformance/entailment-suite/w3c-owl2-rl/, fetched from https://www.w3.org/2009/11/owl-test/all.rdf), graded through the OWL 2 RL forward-materialization chase — the independent oracle for the rule table, which until it existed was scored only by fixtures authored alongside the rules. 50 cases: all 27 positive entailments W3C places inside the RL profile under RDF-BASED semantics, plus ALL 23 negative entailments (soundness is owed on every case, so nothing is filtered by profile there). The negative lane is 23/23 — the chase never derived a triple W3C publishes as NOT entailed, so no unsoundness was found. The positive lane is 11 of 27, and the 16 ledgered divergences are each typed in crates/sparql-conformance/src/owl2_rl.rs::LEDGER — 8 schema-conclusion, 6 negative-conclusion, 1 construct-outside-rl, 1 imports-unresolved. All 16 are structural limits of OWL 2 RL itself: every head in Profiles §4.3 Tables 4–9 is an assertional triple over named terms or `false`, so no conforming RL rule set derives a schema axiom or a negative fact. 0 are ACTIONABLE. Lowered from 17: webont-differentfrom-001 — `a owl:differentFrom b` entails `b owl:differentFrom a`, sound and shaped exactly like prp-symp yet not among the 78 rules, because Table 4's differentFrom rules only ever conclude `false` — now AGREES. It is reached by a rule declared OUTSIDE every specification table: purrdf_entail::extensions(Regime::OwlRl) names ext-eq-diff-sym, rules() and implemented() are both still exactly the same 78 and name none of it, and every rendered report carries an `extension ext-eq-diff-sym` line so a caller that must act only on normative conclusions can tell. This row, not `OWL-RL 78 / 78`, is the W3C entailment-conformance measurement

rdflib LSP drop-in gate.note: rdflib-suite strict xfails: Graph-subclass set-operator identity, rdf:List/Collection mutation, Result.bindings/SELECT* subselect projection, graph-prefix forwarding, aggregate/nested-FILTER evaluation, and ConjunctiveGraph legacy semantics

purrdf.compat parity.note: purrdf.compat differential strict xfails vs rdflib 7.6
